description: HPC Production Trace is provided by Depositing research team via Zenodo. The HPC Production Trace contains approximately 14 million jobs from a 14,376-core production cluster. Its HDF representation includes submission times, user identifiers, requested cores and memory, runtime limits and actual runtimes. Geographic context: unknown; not established by landing-page metadata. Temporal coverage and spatial resolution are not established beyond the source details stated here. The public source page provides documentation and links for obtaining the resource; no data or software archive was downloaded. Documented formats: HDF. The cited material was readable without payment. Licence: CC-BY-4.0, read from the Zenodo record on 2026-09-27; obtaining it is free of charge. The deposit represents one cluster and study release; representativeness and continued maintenance are not established. Potential simulation use: Replay job demand for scheduler and capacity experiments. For catalogue navigation, platform-cloudsim offers related simulation context; this comparison does not assert an implemented connection.
